title: Winter flu clinic every Tuesday
body: Walk-in flu vaccinations run every Tuesday from 09:00 to 12:00 in the community room. No appointment is needed; please bring your NHS number if you have it. Housebound patients can call reception to arrange a home visit.
author: Sister Grace Abbott

title: Repeat prescriptions are moving online
body: From 1 December you can request repeat prescriptions through the patient portal. Requests are checked by the pharmacy team and are usually ready within two working days. Paper requests will still be accepted at reception.
author: Reception team

title: West car park resurfacing
body: The west car park is closed for resurfacing until 30 November. Please use the Willow Lane entrance or the pay-and-display car park opposite the library. The accessible bays by the main door remain open.
author: Estates office

title: MMR catch-up for children aged 1 to 5
body: Children aged 1 to 5 who have not had their second MMR dose are invited to a catch-up clinic. Call reception on 01233 555 014 to book. Please bring your child's red book.
author: Dr. Ravi Menon

title: Extended opening hours from December
body: From 2 December the practice will open at 07:30 on weekdays and stay open until 19:00 on Tuesdays and Thursdays. The pharmacy counter will follow the same hours.
author: Mariam Haddad

title: New physiotherapy clinic
body: Dr. Priya Shah holds a physiotherapy clinic on Monday and Thursday afternoons. Referrals can be made by your GP or by calling reception. The clinic room is on the third floor and is step-free by lift.
author: Dr. Priya Shah

title: Bank holiday closure — 25 December
body: The practice is closed on 25 and 26 December and on 1 January. If you need urgent medical help while we are closed, call NHS 111. For a life-threatening emergency, call 999.
author: Mariam Haddad

title: Pharmacy counter now open on Saturdays
body: The pharmacy counter is open on Saturdays from 09:00 to 12:30. Repeat prescriptions can be collected and medication queries answered. The main reception desk is also open.
author: Amara Boateng

title: Help us keep appointments free
body: If you can no longer attend an appointment, please let us know at least 24 hours in advance. Missed appointments mean another patient waits longer. You can cancel by phone or through the portal.
author: Reception team

title: Free blood pressure checks
body: Drop in for a free blood pressure check on Wednesday mornings between 09:00 and 11:00. No appointment is needed. Our nursing team can also offer advice on home monitoring.
author: Sister Grace Abbott

title: Mental health drop-in moves to Thursdays
body: The weekly mental health drop-in now runs on Thursdays from 14:00 to 16:00 in room 3A. Jonah Field, our mental health counsellor, is available for a confidential conversation. No referral is needed.
author: Jonah Field

title: Step-free entrance and accessible route
body: The main entrance on Willow Lane is step-free. A lift serves all floors, and an accessible toilet is available on the ground floor. Please ask at reception if you need assistance.
author: Estates office

title: Community coffee morning
body: Join us on the first Friday of each month from 10:00 to 11:30 in the community room. Meet neighbours, ask questions and enjoy a free hot drink. Everyone is welcome.
author: Volunteer team

title: Travel vaccination appointments
body: Travel health appointments are available on Wednesday afternoons. Please book at least six weeks before you travel and bring your itinerary. Some vaccines are available on the NHS; others are private.
author: Nurse Daniel Okafor

title: Autumn patient newsletter
body: The autumn edition of our patient newsletter is now available at reception. It includes updates on the new appointment system, flu clinic dates and ways to get involved in the patient participation group.
author: Mariam Haddad

title: Weekend rota change — 29 November
body: Dr. Okonkwo and Nurse Okafor will cover Saturday 29 November. The dispensary will open at 09:30 and the front-desk handover sheet should be updated by Friday 17:00. Please note the change in the shared rota.
author: Mariam Haddad
